title: Help with Fractions

lines.text: Hi Luna. Are you busy? I need help with my maths homework.

I think it's two quarters?
Close. One half is two quarters, so the answer is three quarters.
Oh! Now I see. That's easy.
Try the next one yourself, and I'll check it.
Done. It's five eighths. Is that right?
Yes, perfect! You're a fast learner.
Thanks. Can we study together on Wednesday?
Sure. Come to my house after school.

title: Booking a Birthday Table

lines.text: Casa Verde restaurant, good evening.

Eight thirty is fine.

title: A Day in the Life of a Nurse

lines.text: I'm Rosa, and I'm a nurse in a children's hospital.
I start work at seven in the morning.
First, I check the temperature of each child.
Then I give them their medicine and talk to their parents.
At ten, I help the doctor with new patients.
I have lunch at one, but sometimes I don't have time to eat.
In the afternoon, I read stories to the children.
My favourite part is when a child feels better and smiles.
I finish at five, and I'm usually very tired, but happy.
